articles.title_en: Peaceful entry: Entrepreneurship dynamics during Colombia’s peace agreement
articles.title_cn: 和平进入：哥伦比亚和平协议期间的创业动态
articles.abstract_en: The end of internal conflict is often shaped by political uncertainty and threats of violence recurrence. This implies that the effects of conflict termination on economic activity and specifically entrepreneurship can go in either direction, and we know little about this relationship. Studying Colombia’s recent peace agreement with the FARC guerrilla, and using a difference-in-differences empirical strategy, we document that dynamics of entrepreneurship in traditionally violent areas closely mapped the politics that surrounded the peace agreement. When the agreement was imminent after a 5-decade conflict and violence had plummeted, local investors from all economic sectors established new firms and created jobs. Instead, when the agreement was rejected in a referendum, the party that promoted this rejection raised to power, and violence re-escalated, the rate of firms’ creation rapidly reversed.
articles.abstract_cn: 内部冲突的结束往往受到政治不确定性和暴力复发的威胁的影响。这意味着冲突终止对经济活动，特别是创业的影响可能朝任一方向发展，而我们对这种关系知之甚少。通过研究哥伦比亚最近与哥伦比亚革命武装力量（FARC）游击队达成的和平协议，并采用双重差分实证策略，我们记录了传统暴力地区的创业动态与围绕和平协议的政治紧密对应。当协议在长达5年的冲突后即将达成且暴力已大幅下降时，来自所有经济部门的当地投资者建立了新企业并创造了就业机会。相反，当协议在公投中被否决，推动否决的政党上台，暴力重新升级时，企业创建率迅速逆转。

articles.title_en: Immigration and occupational downgrading in Colombia
articles.title_cn: 移民与哥伦比亚的职业降级
articles.abstract_en: Between 2015–2019, approximately 1.8 million Venezuelans fled an economic and political crisis into neighboring Colombia. Despite being well-educated on average, these migrants disproportionately entered occupations that typically employ less-educated Colombians. I use a model of labor demand with imperfect substitutability between migrants and natives to study the effect of migrant occupational downgrading on native wages and inequality. Counterfactual scenarios reveal that migrant downgrading amplifies the negative wage effect of migration for natives without completed secondary schooling by 30%, and this increases to 80% after allowing for full capital adjustment in the long term. At the same time, migrant downgrading has little consequence for the wages of more-educated natives, who benefit from reduced competition but are harmed by reductions in aggregate productivity. The results highlight the consequences of migrant downgrading for wage inequality and productivity. In developing countries, these consequences are amplified by low imperfect substitutability across education groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2015-2019年间，约有1.8万委内瑞拉人因经济和政治危机逃往邻国哥伦比亚。尽管这些移民平均受教育程度较高，但他们不成比例地进入了通常雇用受教育程度较低的哥伦比亚人的职业。我使用一个劳动力需求模型，该模型考虑了移民与本地人之间的不完全替代性，以研究移民职业降级对本地人工资和不平等的影响。反事实情景显示，移民降级加剧了移民对未完成中学教育的本地人的负面工资效应，增幅为30%，在长期允许资本完全调整后，这一增幅升至80%。与此同时，移民降级对受教育程度较高的本地人的工资影响甚微，他们因竞争减少而受益，但因总生产率下降而受损。结果凸显了移民降级对工资不平等和生产率的后果。在发展中国家，这些后果因教育群体之间的低不完全替代性而被放大。

articles.title_en: Intergenerational mobility around the world: A new database
articles.title_cn: 世界各地的代际流动性：一个新数据库
articles.abstract_en: Using individual data from over 400 household surveys, this paper compiles a global database of intergenerational mobility in education for 153 countries covering 97 percent of the world's population. Intergenerational mobility in education is estimated to be lower in the average developing country than in the average high-income country. Children in the developing world have been less successful at surpassing their parents' education, despite the lower levels of parental education. The poorer the country, the more likely it is that individuals born to parents who do not have an education lack the means to get an education. The world as a whole is estimated to be less mobile than the average country in it, which highlights the importance of the country in which one obtains his/her education.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用超过400项住户调查的个人数据，本文编制了一个涵盖153个国家、覆盖世界人口97%的教育代际流动性全球数据库。平均而言，发展中国家的教育代际流动性低于平均高收入国家。尽管发展中国家父母的受教育水平较低，但其子女在超越父母教育水平方面取得的成功较少。国家越贫穷，出生于未受教育父母之下的个人越可能缺乏接受教育的手段。据估计，整个世界作为一个整体的流动性低于其内部平均国家，这凸显了个人获得教育所在国家的重要性。

articles.title_en: The long-term welfare effects of colonial institutions: Evidence from Central India
articles.title_cn: 殖民制度的长期福利效应：来自印度中部的证据
articles.abstract_en: In Central India, the Narmada River separates two regions that have been ruled by different types of government only during the colonial period, and for reasons independent of their initial economic development. I implement a spatial RDD on village population in the Nineteenth Century as well as in 1901, and I run the same model on proxies of welfare in 2015. My results highlight that divergence has realised where the river overlapped with the colonial border, but not in a neighbouring area where the same Narmada River separates two shores with the same type of former colonial institution. I discuss the following transmission mechanism. The treated group was directly administered by the British with more modern state tools - such as the enforcement of property rights and a transparent taxation system - that made it easier to develop private investment. The most prominent example is the mixed-capital enterprise in charge of the construction of the first trans-continental railway. Infrastructure endowment seems to be crucial for the long-term transmission of the colonial institutional characteristics to the outcomes measured in 2015, which show better average welfare outcomes, as well as higher wealth inequality in the treated group. My work provides an explanation of how the improvement in the quality of the institutions of an embryonic state may sustain the growth of the local markets it deems relevant.
articles.abstract_cn: 在印度中部，纳尔默达河将两个仅在殖民时期由不同类型政府统治的地区分隔开来，且这种分隔与其初始经济发展水平无关。我对十九世纪及1901年的村庄人口实施了空间断点回归设计，并对2015年的福利代理指标运行了相同模型。我的结果强调，在河流与殖民边界重叠的地方出现了分化，但在邻近地区，同一条纳尔默达河分隔的两岸具有相同的前殖民制度类型，却未出现分化。我讨论了以下传导机制。处理组由英国直接管理，采用了更现代的国家工具——如产权执行和透明的税收制度——这使得私人投资更容易发展。最突出的例子是负责建设第一条跨大陆铁路的混合资本企业。基础设施禀赋似乎对于殖民制度特征向2015年所测结果的长期传导至关重要，这些结果显示处理组具有更好的平均福利结果以及更高的财富不平等。我的工作解释了胚胎国家制度质量的提升如何可能维持其认为相关的本地市场的增长。

articles.title_en: Evaluating the impact of general versus vocational education on labor market outcomes in Egypt by means of a regression discontinuity design
articles.title_cn: 评估普通教育与职业教育对埃及劳动力市场结果的影响：基于断点回归设计
articles.abstract_en: This study contributes to the scarce literature in developing countries by causally analyzing the long-term impact of secondary general versus vocational education on labor market outcomes in Egypt. Our regression discontinuity design (RDD) exploits a cutoff in exam scores that tracks students in upper-secondary vocational or general education. Pooling data from the 2012 and 2018 Egypt Labor Market Panel Survey (ELMPS), we find that among male upper-secondary graduates aged 25–49 and employed in the private sector, general education graduates experience a relative advantage in terms of formal employment. We find no impact on employment, public-sector employment for the employed, or wages for those in wage employment. Given the relatively poor prospects of vocational graduates, who account for two-thirds of enrollment at the upper-secondary level, improving the efficiency of vocational upper-secondary education could have a significant impact on the working conditions of many Egyptians.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究通过因果分析埃及中等普通教育与职业教育对劳动力市场结果的长期影响，为发展中国家稀缺的文献做出贡献。我们的断点回归设计（RDD）利用考试分数的截止点，该截止点将学生分流至高中职业或普通教育。汇总2012年和2018年埃及劳动力市场面板调查（ELMPS）的数据，我们发现，在25-49岁、受雇于私营部门的男性高中毕业生中，普通教育毕业生在正规就业方面具有相对优势。我们发现对就业、受雇者的公共部门就业或工资就业者的工资没有影响。鉴于职业毕业生（占高中入学人数的三分之二）的前景相对较差，提高高中职业教育的效率可能对许多埃及人的工作条件产生显著影响。

articles.title_en: Cultural distance, firm boundaries, and global sourcing
articles.title_cn: 文化距离、企业边界与全球采购
articles.abstract_en: Casual observation suggests that cultural differences play an important role in business transactions, yet systematic evidence on this relationship is scarce. This paper provides a novel investigation of the effect of cultural distance on multinational firms’ decisions to integrate their cooperation partners into firm boundaries, rather than transact with independent companies at arm’s-length. To guide our empirical analysis, we develop a simple theoretical model which suggests that (i) cultural distance between contracting parties decreases the relative attractiveness of integration, and (ii) this effect is mitigated in more productive firms. We test these predictions using extensive product-, industry-, and firm-level data. We find a robust negative relationship between cultural distance and the relative attractiveness of integration. In line with our theoretical predictions, we also find that the effect of cultural distance on firm boundaries is less pronounced the higher firm’s productivity.
articles.abstract_cn: 粗略观察表明，文化差异在商业交易中扮演重要角色，然而关于这一关系的系统性证据却很少。本文对文化距离对跨国公司决定将其合作伙伴整合进企业边界，而非与独立公司进行保持距离的交易的影响进行了新颖的研究。为引导我们的实证分析，我们构建了一个简单的理论模型，该模型表明：（i）缔约双方之间的文化距离降低了整合的相对吸引力，（ii）这一效应在生产率更高的企业中有所缓解。我们使用广泛的产品、行业和企业层面数据来检验这些预测。我们发现文化距离与整合的相对吸引力之间存在稳健的负相关关系。与我们的理论预测一致，我们还发现，企业生产率越高，文化距离对企业边界的影响越不显著。

articles.title_en: How do digital platforms affect employment and job search? Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 数字平台如何影响就业与求职？来自印度的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use a randomized control trial to evaluate whether digital platforms improve employment outcomes among vocational training graduates in India. We uploaded a random subset of graduates to a digital platform, and assigned some to receive many text messages about job opportunities. We find evidence of voluntary unemployment: graduates respond to platform access by increasing their reservation wages, and by working significantly less. As good job offers fail to materialize on the platform, some graduates adjust their expectations downwards and resume working. These findings suggest that youth’s beliefs about the effectiveness of matching interventions may reduce their potential impacts on employment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，评估数字平台是否能改善印度职业培训毕业生的就业结果。我们将随机抽取的一部分毕业生上传至数字平台，并给其中一些人发送大量关于工作机会的短信。我们发现了自愿性失业的证据：毕业生因获得平台访问权而提高了保留工资，并显著减少了工作时间。由于平台上未能出现好的工作机会，一些毕业生下调了预期并重新开始工作。这些发现表明，青年对匹配干预有效性的信念可能会降低这些干预对就业的潜在影响。

articles.title_en: Illegal markets and contemporary slavery: Evidence from the mahogany trade in the Amazon
articles.title_cn: 非法市场与当代奴隶制：来自亚马逊桃花心木贸易的证据
articles.abstract_en: Modern slavery is a major global concern, with an estimated 49.7 million people enslaved in 2022. This paper explores the impact of illegal markets on this phenomenon, focusing on the complete shutdown of the mahogany market in the late 90s in Brazil. Utilizing a quasi-experimental research design that exploits the natural variation in the occurrence of mahogany trees in Brazilian municipalities, we employ novel administrative data on labor inspections to assess the effects of this shutdown on modern slavery. Our results indicate that the mahogany market shutdown significantly increased the probability of labor inspections discovering slave labor in affected municipalities. The outcomes are not influenced by coordinated police efforts targeting locations following the alteration in the law. We validate our findings with several robustness exercises.
articles.abstract_cn: 现代奴隶制是一个重大的全球关切，据估计在49.7年有2022万人被奴役。本文探讨了非法市场对这一现象的影响，重点关注巴西在90年代末桃花心木市场的全面关闭。利用准实验研究设计，利用巴西各城市桃花心木出现的自然变异，我们采用关于劳动监察的新型行政数据来评估这一关闭对现代奴隶制的影响。我们的结果表明，桃花心木市场的关闭显著增加了受影响城市劳动监察发现奴隶劳动的概率。这些结果不受针对法律变更后地点的协调警察行动的影响。我们通过多项稳健性检验验证了我们的发现。

articles.title_en: School electrification and academic outcomes in rural Kenya
articles.title_cn: 肯尼亚农村学校电气化与学业成果
articles.abstract_en: Between 2014 and 2016, the number of primary schools with electricity rose from 56% to 94%. Schools in proximity to the grid network were connected to grid electricity, while those located further away received solar photovoltaics. Using this rapid electrification expansion as a source of identifying variation in a panel fixed effects model, the paper estimates the impact on school test scores, enrollment, and completion. Additionally, the paper attempts to quantify the effects of lighting on education performance by relying on the off-grid (solar) electricity coefficients. Using a universe of 8th grade students in public schools in Kenya, the paper finds no evidence that electricity affects test scores or enrollment in the short run. However, off-grid electrification increases completion by 1%. Using off-grid estimates, the paper concludes that lighting has a small positive impact on completion but not on test scores or enrollment. This is an extremely short-term evaluation and in the long-run electrification may have larger impacts.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2014至2016年间，拥有电力的小学比例从56%上升至94%。靠近电网的学校接入电网电力，而距离较远的学校则获得太阳能光伏发电。利用这一快速电气化扩张作为面板固定效应模型中的识别变异来源，本文估计了其对学校考试成绩、入学率和完成率的影响。此外，本文尝试通过依赖离网（太阳能）电力系数来量化照明对教育表现的影响。利用肯尼亚公立学校8年级学生的总体数据，本文发现没有证据表明电力在短期内影响考试成绩或入学率。然而，离网电气化使完成率提高了1%。利用离网估计，本文得出结论：照明对完成率有较小的正向影响，但对考试成绩或入学率没有影响。这是一项极短期的评估，从长远来看，电气化可能产生更大的影响。

articles.title_en: TV in times of political uncertainty: Evidence from the 2017 elections in Kenya
articles.title_cn: 政治不确定性时期的电视：来自肯尼亚2017选举的证据
articles.abstract_en: What is the impact of television during periods of political crisis? This paper examines the nullification of the 2017 presidential election in Kenya, followed by the organization of a repeat ballot, which sparked widespread protests and heightened uncertainty. Leveraging exogenous variations in television signal expansion since 2013, I assess the influence of television reception on voter turnout in both the initial and repeat ballots, as well as on electoral protests. The findings reveal that television did not significantly impact turnout in the first election; however, its effects varied across political camps in the repeat election. Turnout decreased by 3pp in pro-opposition areas but was a 7pp larger in pro-government strongholds. I contend that television played an informative role during a period characterized by high levels of uncertainty. Employing text analysis methods, I document the convergence of news content before the recall election, with a particular emphasis on the ongoing protests. Furthermore, the distinctive tone of coverage by the state-owned TV station may have bolstered the call for participation in the second poll.
articles.abstract_cn: 政治危机时期电视的影响是什么？本文考察了肯尼亚2017总统选举结果被宣布无效，随后组织重新投票，这一事件引发了广泛的抗议活动并加剧了不确定性。利用自2013以来电视信号扩展的外生变化，我评估了电视接收对初次投票和重新投票中选民投票率以及选举抗议活动的影响。研究结果显示，电视在第一次选举中对投票率没有显著影响；然而，在重新选举中，其影响因政治阵营而异。在反对派占优地区，投票率下降了3个百分点，而在政府支持者占优地区，投票率则高出7个百分点。我认为，在高度不确定性的时期，电视发挥了信息传递的作用。运用文本分析方法，我记录了重新选举前新闻内容的趋同现象，特别是对持续抗议活动的报道。此外，国有电视台独特的报道基调可能增强了第二次投票的参与号召力。

articles.title_en: Changing local customs: The long run impacts of Christian missions on female genital cutting in Africa
articles.title_cn: 改变当地习俗：基督教传教对非洲女性割礼的长期影响
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the long-run impacts of Christian missions on female genital cutting (FGC) in Africa. Our empirical analysis draws on historical data on the locations of early European missions geographically matched with Demographic and Health Survey data on FGC practices of around 410,000 respondents from 42 surveys performed over a 30-year period in 14 African countries. We use ethnographic data on pre-colonial FGC to show that the location of missions was not correlated with the practice of FGC in the local population. Our benchmark estimates imply that a person living 10 km from a historical mission is 4–6 percentage points less likely to have undergone FGC than someone living 100 km from a mission site. Similarly, an additional mission per 1000 km2 in one's ancestral ethnic homeland decreases the probability of having undergone FGC by around 8 percentage points. The effect is robust to numerous specifications and control variables.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了基督教传教对非洲女性割礼（FGC）的长期影响。我们的实证分析利用了早期欧洲传教站位置的历史数据，并与来自14个非洲国家、在30年期间进行的42项调查中约410,000名受访者的FGC实践的人口与健康调查数据进行了地理匹配。我们使用前殖民时期的民族志数据来表明，传教站的位置与当地人口的FGC实践不相关。我们的基准估计表明，居住在距历史传教站10公里处的人，其接受FGC的可能性比居住在距传教站100公里处的人低4-6个百分点。同样，在其祖先族裔故乡每1000平方公里增加一个传教站，会使接受FGC的概率降低约8个百分点。该效应在众多规格和控制变量下均稳健。

articles.title_en: Helping families help themselves: The (Un)intended impacts of a digital parenting program
articles.title_cn: 帮助家庭自助：数字育儿项目的（非）预期影响
articles.abstract_en: Parenting practices play a crucial role in child development. We evaluate the impact of a free digital stress management and positive parenting intervention designed to improve caregiver’s mental health and positive caregiver–child interactions in El Salvador. Drawing on the prior success of in-person interventions, we study the effects of digital intervention delivery and examine differential treatment effects by caregiver’s sex. Using an individual-level experiment, we find that the intervention increased stress and anxiety and lowered caregiver–child interactions among male caregivers. In contrast, among female caregivers, we did not detect changes in mental health and observed a decrease in the use of physical violence against children. We also find that family structure and the severity of economic deprivation greatly moderated the intervention’s impact, especially among male caregivers. Our findings indicate that one-size-fits-all digital parenting interventions may not serve all caregivers effectively, emphasizing the need for thorough evaluations prior to extensive implementation.
articles.abstract_cn: 育儿实践在儿童发展中起着至关重要的作用。我们评估了一项免费的数字化压力管理和积极育儿干预措施在萨尔瓦多的影响，该干预旨在改善照护者的心理健康和积极的照护者与儿童互动。借鉴面对面干预的成功经验，我们研究了数字化干预实施的效果，并考察了按照护者性别划分的差异化处理效应。通过一项个体层面的实验，我们发现该干预增加了男性照护者的压力和焦虑，并降低了他们与儿童的互动。相比之下，在女性照护者中，我们未检测到心理健康的变化，但观察到对儿童使用体罚的情况有所减少。我们还发现，家庭结构和经济匮乏的严重程度在很大程度上调节了干预的影响，尤其是在男性照护者中。我们的研究结果表明，一刀切的数字化育儿干预可能无法有效服务于所有照护者，强调了在广泛实施前进行彻底评估的必要性。

articles.title_en: Asset transfers and anti-poverty programs: Experimental evidence from Tanzania
articles.title_cn: 资产转移与反贫困项目：来自坦桑尼亚的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We use a set of randomized experiments to examine the impact of a group business development program implemented by the Tanzanian government, along with a set of complementary training and cash transfer interventions targeted to vulnerable households in rural areas. In contrast with much of the recent literature, we find little effect of the business development program. While most enterprises remain operative three years after formation, even our highest estimates of effective wage rates suggest returns roughly equivalent to the opportunity cost of time for these households. Unconditional and unanticipated lump-sum cash transfers to randomly selected members of these groups induce all members to invest more in the enterprise, with seemingly little to no return on these marginal investments. Our results emphasize the importance of profitability as the key motivation for asset transfer-based social protection programs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一组随机实验来考察坦桑尼亚政府实施的团体商业发展项目，以及针对农村地区脆弱家庭的一系列补充培训和现金转移干预措施的影响。与近期许多文献相反，我们发现商业发展项目的影响甚微。尽管大多数企业在成立三年后仍在运营，但即使是我们对有效工资率的最高估计也表明，回报大致相当于这些家庭的时间机会成本。向这些团体中随机选择的成员提供无条件且未预期的整笔现金转移，促使所有成员更多地投资于企业，但这些边际投资似乎几乎没有回报。我们的结果强调了盈利能力作为基于资产转移的社会保护项目关键动机的重要性。

articles.title_en: Fertility and delayed migration: How son preference protects young girls against mother–child separation
articles.title_cn: 生育与延迟迁移：儿子偏好如何保护年轻女孩免受母子分离
articles.abstract_en: Mother–child separation harms children's development. This concern is particularly relevant in rapidly urbanizing societies with massive migration. However, factors that increase the probability of children becoming separated from their migrating parents are not well understood. In this study, we find that during early childhood, specifically at the age of 2 years, girls are less likely to become separated from their parents than boys are. This is due to son preference, which leads parents to attempt to have another child after a firstborn daughter, mostly when the daughter is 2 years old. Furthermore, migrant women often stay in their hometowns during pregnancy, which prevents mother–daughter separation. Our placebo tests indicate that this gender gap at the age of 2 years does not exist in provinces with birth interval restrictions or strict one-child policies. The gap is wider in regions with stronger son preference or higher historical population outflow rates.
articles.abstract_cn: 母子分离对儿童发展有害。在快速城市化且伴随大规模迁移的社会中，这一问题尤为突出。然而，增加儿童与迁移父母分离概率的因素尚不明确。在本研究中，我们发现，在幼儿期，特别是2岁时，女孩与父母分离的可能性低于男孩。这是由于儿子偏好，导致父母在第一个孩子是女儿后，大多在女儿2岁时尝试生育另一个孩子。此外，迁移女性在怀孕期间常留在老家，这防止了母女分离。我们的安慰剂检验表明，在实行生育间隔限制或严格独生子女政策的省份，2岁时的性别差距不存在。在儿子偏好更强或历史人口流出率更高的地区，这一差距更大。

articles.title_en: Religious identity, trust, reciprocity, and prosociality: Theory and evidence
articles.title_cn: 宗教身份、信任、互惠与亲社会行为：理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: We use the trust and the dictator games to explore the effects of religious identity on trust, trustworthiness, prosociality, and conditional reciprocity within a beliefs-based model. We provide a novel, rigorous, theoretical model to derive the relevant predictions, which are then tested in lab-in-the-field experiments in the Indian states of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh. We find strong evidence of the effects of religious identity on the belief hierarchies, and the chosen actions, of Hindu and Muslim subjects. Priming for a religious identity has little effect on Hindu subjects but it enhances religious polarization in beliefs and actions among Muslim subjects. There is taste-based discrimination but no statistical discrimination. All our underlying assumptions on beliefs, and their dependence on priming and identity are confirmed by the data, identifying a precise beliefs-based mechanism for the effects of religious identity. More religious subjects expect greater prosociality/reciprocity and often are more prosocial/reciprocal.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用信任博弈和独裁者博弈，在基于信念的模型中探讨宗教身份对信任、可信度、亲社会行为以及条件性互惠的影响。我们提出了一个新颖、严谨的理论模型来推导相关预测，并在印度比哈尔邦和北方邦的实地实验室实验中进行了检验。我们发现了强有力的证据表明宗教身份对印度教和穆斯林受试者的信念层级和选择行为有影响。宗教身份的启动对印度教受试者影响甚微，但增强了穆斯林受试者在信念和行为上的宗教极化。存在基于偏好的歧视，但不存在统计性歧视。我们关于信念及其对启动和身份依赖的所有基本假设均得到数据证实，从而确定了宗教身份影响的一个精确的基于信念的机制。更虔诚的受试者预期更多的亲社会行为/互惠，并且往往表现出更多的亲社会行为/互惠。

articles.title_en: Economic shocks and infant health: Evidence from a trade reform in Brazil
articles.title_cn: 经济冲击与婴儿健康：来自巴西贸易改革的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using a uniquely rich set of data sources spanning more than 3,000 Brazilian municipalities over a horizon of 25 years, we investigate the effects of changes in local economic conditions generated by a trade liberalization reform on infant mortality. We exploit variation in import tariff reductions, together with differences in the baseline industry composition across locations, for identification. We find that areas with greater exposure to the trade-induced economic shock experienced a larger decline in infant mortality. In our exploration of mechanisms, we find the most support for the hypothesis that worse labor market opportunities make it less costly undertake health-improving behaviors that are time intensive. Consistent with this hypothesis, we observe a significant decline in female employment rates and an increase in the use of basic health services among women of childbearing ages and infants. We also document that the rollout of a community-based intervention that brings basic health services to the home in a flexible fashion lowers the magnitude of the mortality effect, providing further evidence in favor of the parental time mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用跨越巴西超过3,000个城市、时间跨度达25年的独特丰富数据源，我们研究了贸易自由化改革引起的当地经济状况变化对婴儿死亡率的影响。我们利用进口关税削减的差异以及各地区基线产业结构的不同来进行识别。我们发现，受贸易引发的经济冲击影响更大的地区，婴儿死亡率下降幅度更大。在机制探索中，我们最支持以下假设：较差的劳动力市场机会使得采取耗时但有益健康的行为成本更低。与该假设一致，我们观察到育龄妇女和婴儿中女性就业率显著下降，基本健康服务使用增加。我们还记录了以灵活方式将基本健康服务送到家中的社区干预措施的推广降低了死亡率效应的幅度，这进一步支持了父母时间机制。

articles.title_en: Learning effects of conditional cash transfers: The role of class size and composition
articles.title_cn: 有条件现金转移支付的学习效应：班级规模与构成的作用
articles.abstract_en: A large literature has documented the positive effects of conditional cash transfer programs on school enrollment. However, evidence on their learning impacts is mixed and provides little insights into the mechanisms at play. Using a regression discontinuity analysis of a program implemented at scale in Morocco, we identify a substantial decrease in dropout rates in treated municipalities, which increased both class size and heterogeneity in class composition, and ultimately had negative impacts on children’s test scores. These patterns indicate that, when there is a lack of coordinated supply-side responses, conditional cash transfer programs can constrain learning by putting additional pressure on existing resources. They also highlight the importance of class size and composition for children learning.
articles.abstract_cn: 大量文献记录了有条件现金转移支付项目对入学率的积极影响。然而，关于其学习影响的证据不一，且对其作用机制了解甚少。通过对摩洛哥大规模实施的项目进行断点回归分析，我们发现受助市镇的辍学率显著下降，这增加了班级规模和班级构成的异质性，并最终对儿童的测试成绩产生了负面影响。这些模式表明，在缺乏协调的供给侧响应时，有条件现金转移支付项目可能通过对现有资源施加额外压力而制约学习。它们也凸显了班级规模和构成对儿童学习的重要性。

articles.title_en: Information and behavior: Evidence from fertilizer quantity recommendations in Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 信息与行为：来自孟加拉国化肥数量建议的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use a field experiment in Bangladesh to test if two types of variety-specific fertilizer recommendations – government provided, community-level recommendations and plot-specific recommendations based on individual soil tests – affect fertilizer use, yield, and profits. The treatments have a limited effect on quantity of most fertilizer types used by farmers. One exception is the case of TSP (phosphate fertilizer), which is recommended for all varieties but recommended quantities are significantly lower than the baseline average usage. A minority of treatment farmers over-react to the recommendations by stopping TSP use after the intervention. In the soil-testing treatment arm farmers also shift their seed choice to varieties for which their baseline fertilizer consumption aligns with the recommendation. Opting out of using TSP, an essential fertilizer, ultimately hurts productivity as farmers in the community-based recommendation arm experience a 4% yield reduction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在孟加拉国进行了一项田间实验，以检验两类品种特异性化肥建议——政府提供的社区级建议和基于个体土壤测试的地块特定建议——是否影响化肥使用、产量和利润。这些处理对农民使用的大多数化肥类型的数量影响有限。一个例外是TSP（磷肥），所有品种均推荐使用，但建议数量显著低于基线平均使用量。少数处理组农民对建议反应过度，在干预后停止使用TSP。在土壤测试处理组中，农民还将其种子选择转向其基线化肥消费与建议相符的品种。放弃使用TSP这种必需肥料最终损害了生产力，因为社区级建议组的农民经历了4%的产量下降。

articles.title_en: Adaptation to temperature extremes in Chinese agriculture, 1981 to 2010
articles.title_cn: 中国农业对极端温度的适应，1981年至2010年
articles.abstract_en: Causal evidence for adaptation effects of specific agricultural instruments is scant but important for identifying potentially useful adaptive measures for climate change in the future. To address this gap, we leverage quasi-experimental variations in irrigation induced by a natural experiment for irrigation expansion started in 1996 and quantify the contribution of irrigation access to the overall adaptation effect. There are three primary findings. First, using a period-specific panel fixed effect model, the analysis shows a significant decline in the temperature-related yield loss in the post-1996 period compared to before, indicating a substantial overall adaptation effect. Second, estimation of marginal adaptation effects of inputs points to irrigation as the central input for adaptation among the inputs observed in the data. Third, using a difference-in-differences approach united with the panel methodology for identifying temperature effects, we show that the presence of the irrigation expansion experiment significantly mitigated the high temperature impacts on crop yields, with increased irrigation through the natural experiment accounting for about 40% of the overall adaptation effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于特定农业工具适应效应的因果证据很少，但对于识别未来气候变化中潜在有用的适应措施至关重要。为弥补这一空白，我们利用1996年开始的灌溉扩展自然实验引起的灌溉准实验变化，并量化灌溉获取对整体适应效应的贡献。主要有三个发现。首先，使用时期特定的面板固定效应模型，分析显示1996年之后与之前相比，与温度相关的产量损失显著下降，表明存在显著的整体适应效应。其次，对投入的边际适应效应估计表明，在数据中观察到的投入中，灌溉是适应的核心投入。第三，使用双重差分方法与面板方法相结合来识别温度效应，我们表明灌溉扩展实验的存在显著减轻了高温对作物产量的影响，通过自然实验增加的灌溉约占整体适应效应的40%。

articles.title_en: Respondent biases in agricultural household surveys
articles.title_cn: 农业家庭调查中的受访者偏差
articles.abstract_en: Two sources of respondent bias introduce measurement error into household statistics: asymmetric information between the proxy respondent and the individual on whom they report; and aggregation bias when a proxy respondent reports on a household-level outcome across multiple individuals. We estimate the effects of respondent biases in a survey experiment in Burkina Faso by varying who reports on the agricultural production of household members. We find respondent biases are not solely attributable to asymmetric information. Choosing a household head proxy lowers aggregation biases, but results in both over and under-estimates of agricultural variables relative to random proxies. Random proxies systematically under report agricultural statistics. Self-reporting protocols increase enumerator work days by only 5% indicating a high bias-cost tradeoff in choosing proxy response over self-reports. Survey designers should weight whether proxy bias magnitude or direction of bias are more significant threats to parameter estimation when determining their proxy response protocol.
articles.abstract_cn: 受访者偏差的两个来源给家庭统计引入了测量误差：代理受访者与其所报告个体之间的信息不对称；以及当代理受访者跨多个个体报告家庭层面结果时的聚合偏差。我们在布基纳法索的一项调查实验中，通过改变谁报告家庭成员农业生产来估计受访者偏差的影响。我们发现受访者偏差并非仅归因于信息不对称。选择户主作为代理降低了聚合偏差，但与随机代理相比，导致农业变量的高估和低估。随机代理系统性地低估农业统计。自我报告协议仅将访员工作日增加了5%，表明在选择代理回应而非自我报告时存在高偏差-成本权衡。调查设计者在确定其代理回应协议时，应权衡代理偏差的幅度或方向哪个对参数估计构成更显著的威胁。

articles.title_en: Does survey mode matter? Comparing in-person and phone agricultural surveys in India
articles.title_cn: 调查模式是否重要？比较印度面对面与电话农业调查
articles.abstract_en: Ubiquitous mobile phone ownership makes phone surveying an attractive method of low-cost data collection. We explore differences between in-person and phone survey measures of agricultural production collected for an impact evaluation in India. Phone responses have greater mean and variance, a difference that persists even within a subset of respondents that answered the same question over both modes. Treatment effect estimation remains stable across survey mode, but estimates are less precise when using phone data. These patterns are informative for cost and sample size considerations in study design and for aggregating evidence across study sites or time periods.
articles.abstract_cn: 手机拥有量的普及使得电话调查成为一种低成本数据收集的有吸引力的方法。我们探讨了在印度进行的一项影响评估中，面对面和电话调查所收集的农业生产测量值之间的差异。电话回答具有更大的均值和方差，即使在通过两种模式回答同一问题的受访者子集中，这种差异仍然存在。处理效应估计在调查模式间保持稳定，但使用电话数据时估计精度较低。这些模式对于研究设计中的成本和样本量考虑以及跨研究地点或时间段汇总证据具有参考意义。

articles.title_en: Risk, arbitrage, and spatial price relationships: Insights from China's hog market under the African Swine Fever
articles.title_cn: 风险、套利与空间价格关系：来自非洲猪瘟下中国生猪市场的洞察
articles.abstract_en: Spatial market integration, an important means to increase market efficiency and boost economic development, is often affected by policy changes such as trade liberalization and trade restrictions. With unique weekly data on provincial hog prices, we use the 2018 outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF) in China and the subsequent ban on cross-province shipment of hogs as a natural experiment to study dynamic spatial mechanisms underlying market integration. We employ a high-dimensional spatial model to estimate pairwise inter-province price links over several periods around the ASF outbreak for 29 Chinese provinces. Regressions reveal that a greater inter-province distance weakens the spatial price links post-ban, but not before the ban, which indicates insufficient arbitrage likely due to imperfect public information regarding ASF. The temporary market segmentation implies substantial dead-weight-loss. Our findings highlight the role of public information on risks in maintaining market integration and efficiency under supply-side disruptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 空间市场整合是提高市场效率和促进经济发展的重要手段，但往往受到贸易自由化和贸易限制等政策变化的影响。利用独特的省级生猪价格周度数据，我们将2018年中国非洲猪瘟（ASF）爆发及随后禁止跨省调运生猪作为自然实验，研究市场整合背后的动态空间机制。我们采用高维空间模型，估计了非洲猪瘟爆发前后几个时期内29个中国省份之间两两省际价格联系。回归结果显示，禁令后，省际距离越大，空间价格联系越弱，但禁令前并非如此，这表明套利不足可能源于关于非洲猪瘟的公共信息不完善。暂时的市场分割意味着巨大的无谓损失。我们的发现强调了公共信息在供给侧中断情况下维持市场整合和效率中的作用。

articles.title_en: Supporting early childhood development remotely: Experimental evidence from SMS messages
articles.title_cn: 远程支持儿童早期发展：来自短信的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Using a randomized field experiment in Costa Rica, we estimate the effect of providing parents of preschool students with regular text messages offering ways to engage their children in educational activities at home. After 15 weeks of intervention, the cognitive skills of children whose families were assigned to the program were 0.11–0.12 standard deviations higher than the control group. We find suggestive evidence that the effect was driven by an increase in parents’ involvement as they conducted the activities proposed in the text message campaign.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用在哥斯达黎加进行的一项随机实地实验，我们估计了向学龄前儿童家长定期发送短信、提供在家参与教育活动方式的效果。经过15周的干预，被分配到该项目的家庭中儿童的认知技能比对照组高出0.11-0.12个标准差。我们发现有提示性的证据表明，这一效果是由家长参与度的提高所驱动的，因为他们执行了短信活动中提议的活动。

articles.title_en: The dual role of insurance in input use: Mitigating risk versus curtailing incentives
articles.title_cn: 保险在投入使用中的双重作用：缓解风险与抑制激励
articles.abstract_en: Insurance can encourage the use of risk-increasing inputs, but it can also decrease people’s incentives to exert effort when the latter is difficult to monitor. This effort reduction can be associated with a decrease in the use of effort-complementary inputs. I study a model of risk-sharing that allows for both effects of insurance on input use and use the latest ICRISAT panel to structurally estimate it. Median fertilizer use is almost three times higher under no sharing than under full insurance for reasonable levels of risk aversion. A subsidy that halves fertilizer prices increases farmers’ welfare by 37% in consumption-equivalent terms.
articles.abstract_cn: 保险可以鼓励使用增加风险的投入，但也可能降低人们在难以监督努力时的激励。这种努力减少可能与努力互补性投入的使用减少相关。我研究了一个允许保险对投入使用产生这两种影响的风险分担模型，并使用最新的ICRISAT面板数据进行结构估计。在合理的风险厌恶水平下，无分担时的中位数化肥使用量几乎是完全保险下的三倍。将化肥价格减半的补贴在消费等价条件下使农民福利提高37%。

articles.title_en: Winning and losing the resource lottery: Governance after uncertain oil discoveries
articles.title_cn: 资源抽签的赢与输：不确定石油发现后的治理
articles.abstract_en: Natural resource discoveries are often followed by delays and uncertain production outcomes, creating challenges for governments that anticipate resource revenues. I leverage exogenous subnational variation in offshore oil discoveries in Brazil to identify dynamic effects of discovery news and revenue shocks on local public finances, public goods provision, and politics. Municipalities where discoveries are realized enjoy significant growth in revenues and spending, but fail to improve public goods provision or stimulate economic activity. Municipalities that experience discovery announcements but never receive windfalls suffer long-term declines in revenues, investment, and public goods provision relative to never-treated controls. I show that electoral responses underlie these dynamics: discovery announcements draw less-educated candidates into local politics, and shortfalls between anticipated and realized oil revenues increase political turnover. Findings highlight discovery uncertainty as a fundamental resource governance challenge, and reveal mismanagement of windfalls and adjustment costs after disappointment as two faces of the Resource Curse.
articles.abstract_cn: 自然资源发现往往伴随着延迟和不确定的生产结果，给预期资源收入的政府带来挑战。我利用巴西近海石油发现中外生的次国家变异，来识别发现新闻和收入冲击对地方公共财政、公共品供给和政治的动态效应。实现发现的市镇在收入和支出上享有显著增长，但未能改善公共品供给或刺激经济活动。经历发现公告但从未获得意外之财的市镇，相对于从未处理的对照组，在收入、投资和公共品供给上遭受长期下降。我表明选举反应是这些动态的基础：发现公告吸引了教育程度较低的候选人进入地方政治，而预期与实际石油收入之间的缺口增加了政治更替。研究结果强调发现不确定性是资源治理的根本挑战，并揭示意外之财的管理不善和失望后的调整成本是资源诅咒的两面。

articles.title_en: From wells to wealth? Government transfers and human capital
articles.title_cn: 从油井到财富？政府转移支付与人力资本
articles.abstract_en: To study the causal impact of oil royalties on human capital, we exploit quasi-experimental variation arising from a law in Ecuador that prescribes an algorithm to assign oil royalties to municipalities regardless of their oil-producing status. We find that royalties increase the likelihood of students completing primary and secondary education. Students reaching high school are also more likely to pass and excel on the exit exam. Furthermore, schools are more likely to remain open, increase their size, and become more road-accessible. However, the likelihood of students pursuing higher education decreases as they face steeper opportunity costs when labor demand increases.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了研究石油特许权使用费对人力资本的因果影响，我们利用了厄瓜多尔一项法律产生的准实验变异，该法律规定了一个算法，将石油特许权使用费分配给各市镇，无论其是否产油。我们发现，特许权使用费增加了学生完成小学和中学教育的可能性。进入高中的学生也更有可能在毕业考试中通过并表现出色。此外，学校更有可能保持开放、扩大规模，并且交通更加便利。然而，学生接受高等教育的可能性会降低，因为当劳动力需求增加时，他们面临更高的机会成本。

articles.title_en: The Generalized System of Preferences and NGO activism
articles.title_cn: 普遍优惠制与非政府组织行动主义
articles.abstract_en: Can NGOs contribute to the implementation of Labor Laws in a developing country? We exploit as a quasi-natural experiment the renegotiation of the Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) between the US and Indonesia in 1994, which induced the Indonesian government to raise the level of the legal minimum wage. Using data from Indonesian manufacturing firms, a diff-in-diff analysis and an event study show that the activism of workers’ rights groups helped increase firm-level average wages up to the minimum-wage level, not only inside but also outside the export sector. Labor NGO activism helped to implement the new minimum wage standards in a country that lacked strong governmental institutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 非政府组织能否促进发展中国家劳动法的实施？我们利用美国与印度尼西亚在1994年重新谈判普遍优惠制（GSP）作为准自然实验，该谈判促使印度尼西亚政府提高了法定最低工资水平。利用印度尼西亚制造业企业的数据，双重差分分析和事件研究表明，工人权利组织的行动主义有助于提高企业平均工资至最低工资水平，不仅在出口部门内部，也在出口部门之外。在缺乏强大政府机构的印度尼西亚，劳工非政府组织的行动主义有助于实施新的最低工资标准。

articles.title_en: Optimal Infrastructure after Trade Reform in India
articles.title_cn: 印度贸易改革后的最优基础设施
articles.abstract_en: Lower tariffs typically raise productivity, production, and trade, increasing the benefits from building infrastructure. Infrastructure spending by governments should therefore increase after countries open up to trade. I test this hypothesis empirically using a trade reform in India and find that a 1 percentage point reduction in tariffs increased states’ infrastructure spending by 0.5% between 1991 and 2001. To understand the mechanisms behind my empirical findings, I develop and calibrate a multi-region model of international trade, private capital accumulation, and infrastructure spending, in which each government chooses such spending to maximize their state’s welfare. I find if governments choose infrastructure following the reform optimally, infrastructure would have increased by 60% on average. The actual increase, based on my empirical findings, was about 29%. Counterfactual exercises show that raising aggregate infrastructure towards its optimal following the trade reform will result in state GDP to increase by 7% points on average.
articles.abstract_cn: 降低关税通常会提高生产率、生产和贸易，从而增加建设基础设施的收益。因此，各国在开放贸易后，政府的基础设施支出应增加。我利用印度的贸易改革对这一假设进行了实证检验，发现关税每降低1个百分点，在0.5%年至1991年间，各邦的基础设施支出增加了2001。为了理解我实证发现背后的机制，我开发并校准了一个包含国际贸易、私人资本积累和基础设施支出的多区域模型，其中每个政府选择此类支出以最大化其所在邦的福利。我发现，如果政府在改革后按照最优方式选择基础设施，基础设施平均将增加60%。根据我的实证发现，实际增幅约为29%。反事实实验表明，在贸易改革后，将总体基础设施提高到最优水平将使各邦GDP平均增加7%个百分点。

articles.title_en: Tariff overhang and aid: Theory and empirics
articles.title_cn: 关税余量与外援：理论与实证
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider aid payments as a possible explanation for tariff overhangs. We set up a theoretical model in which rich countries use development aid to pay for tariff concessions by poorer countries. The more aid they receive as compensation, the more poor countries reduce the applied tariff below the bound tariff rate. Anticipating this mechanism, countries can negotiate a bound tariff rate that induces the joint optimal applied tariff and aid as outcomes. We empirically examine the relationship between tariff overhangs and donor aid preferences using detailed data on WTO members’ bound and applied tariff rates under the Uruguay agreement. The data sample contains a predominant majority of WTO members that are aid recipients under the Uruguay agreement. Our results provide support for the model’s aid-for-trade mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们将援助支付视为关税余量的一个可能解释。我们建立了一个理论模型，其中富裕国家使用发展援助来支付较贫穷国家的关税减让。它们作为补偿获得的援助越多，贫穷国家将实际关税降低到约束关税水平以下的程度就越大。预见到这一机制，各国可以谈判一个约束关税税率，该税率诱导联合最优的实际关税和援助作为结果。我们使用乌拉圭协议下WTO成员约束和实际关税税率的详细数据，实证检验了关税余量与捐助国援助偏好之间的关系。数据样本包含了乌拉圭协议下作为援助接受者的绝大多数WTO成员。我们的结果为模型的援助换贸易机制提供了支持。

articles.title_en: Rural road stimulus and the role of matching mandates on economic recovery in China
articles.title_cn: 农村公路刺激计划与配套要求在中国经济复苏中的作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the implications for economic recovery of a rural road stimulus program in China that led to the sudden suspension of local matching mandates. The main results reveal that a temporary cost share exemption stimulates short-term income growth in treated villages. As an explanation, I find that a cost share exemption leads to larger increases on local investment mainly on allied road improvements and to a lesser extent support for rural enterprise development and agricultural services. The observed crowding-in effects are further linked to the reallocation of households out of agriculture and a rise in entrepreneurial activities by returning migrants. The findings imply that matching mandates impede the ability of fiscally constrained locales to mobilize sufficient resources to cover their share of project costs, contributing to inadequate road investment from upper-levels of government. Suspending matching mandate helps to relax local budget constraints, stimulating income and local multipliers that help to accelerate economic recovery.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了中国一项农村公路刺激计划对经济复苏的影响，该计划导致地方配套要求突然暂停。主要结果显示，临时成本分摊豁免促进了处理村短期收入增长。作为解释，我发现成本分摊豁免导致地方投资更大增长，主要是在相关道路改善方面，其次是对农村企业发展和农业服务的支持。观察到的挤入效应进一步与农户从农业中转移以及返乡移民创业活动的增加有关。研究结果表明，配套要求阻碍了财政受限地区调动足够资源以覆盖其项目成本份额的能力，导致上级政府道路投资不足。暂停配套要求有助于放松地方预算约束，刺激收入和地方乘数效应，从而加速经济复苏。

articles.title_en: The limits of hegemony: U.S. banks and Chilean firms in the Cold War
articles.title_cn: 霸权的限度：冷战中的美国银行与智利企业
articles.abstract_en: Governments in hegemonic states use economic sanctions to induce changes in other countries. What happens to international business networks when these sanctions are in place? We use new historical firm-level data to document the destruction of financial relations between U.S. banks and Chilean firms after socialist Salvador Allende took office in 1970. Business reports and stock prices suggest that firms were mostly unaffected by having fewer links with U.S. banks. Substitution of financial relations towards domestic banks appears to be the key mechanism explaining these findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 霸权国家的政府使用经济制裁来诱导其他国家的变革。当这些制裁实施时，国际商业网络会发生什么？我们使用新的历史企业层面数据，记录了社会主义者萨尔瓦多·阿连德于1970年就职后，美国银行与智利企业之间金融关系的破坏。商业报告和股价表明，企业与美国银行联系减少大多未受影响。金融关系向国内银行的替代似乎是解释这些发现的关键机制。

articles.title_en: Improved menstrual health and the workplace: An RCT with female Bangladeshi garment workers
articles.title_cn: 改善月经健康与工作场所：针对孟加拉国女性服装工人的随机对照试验
articles.abstract_en: Menstrual hygiene practices in low-income countries are often limited by lack of finances and information, with potentially adverse consequences for women’s well-being and workplace outcomes. In a randomized controlled trial with around 1,900 female workers from four Bangladeshi garment factories, we relax both constraints individually and jointly by providing free sanitary pads and information on hygienic menstrual practices. Both access to sanitary pads and information improve menstrual practices, either by the adoption of new products, or by knowledge gains and improved use of traditional materials, and both interventions improve health outcomes. However, these positive effects do not translate to better labor outcomes, such as earnings and work attendance.
articles.abstract_cn: 低收入国家的月经卫生习惯往往受到资金和信息缺乏的限制，这可能对女性的福祉和工作场所结果产生不利影响。在一项针对来自四家孟加拉国服装工厂的约1,900名女性工人的随机对照试验中，我们通过提供免费卫生巾和卫生月经习惯信息，分别和联合地放松了这两种限制。获得卫生巾和信息都能改善月经习惯，要么通过采用新产品，要么通过知识获取和改善传统材料的使用，并且两种干预措施都能改善健康结果。然而，这些积极效果并未转化为更好的劳动结果，如收入和出勤率。

articles.title_en: Providing procedural knowledge: A field experiment to encourage resource conservation in Namibia
articles.title_cn: 提供程序性知识：纳米比亚鼓励资源节约的实地实验
articles.abstract_en: I conduct a large-scale field experiment (N = 14876) with a public water utility in Namibia to encourage water conservation during a drought. Providing a short list of specific conservation strategies via text message decreases residential water consumption by around 5.3 percent. Other treatment arms that ask individuals to use and develop their own strategies are ineffective, suggesting that individuals may lack knowledge on how to reduce their water consumption effectively. This interpretation is corroborated by survey evidence as most respondents struggle to name effective conservation strategies. As a secondary outcome, I examine whether the intervention influences the payment of water utility bills. Utility bills are often not paid in full in my setting, which affects the fiscal sustainability (i.e., cost recovery) of the water utility. I find that payments do not decrease. This implies that customers pay a larger amount of their bill, since they consume less water without reducing payments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我在纳米比亚与一家公共水务公司进行了一项大规模实地实验（N = 14,876），旨在鼓励干旱期间节约用水。通过短信提供一份简短的具体节水策略清单，使居民用水量减少了约5.3%。其他要求个人使用并制定自己策略的处理组无效，这表明个人可能缺乏如何有效减少用水量的知识。这一解释得到了调查证据的佐证，因为大多数受访者难以说出有效的节水策略。作为次要结果，我考察了该干预是否影响水费账单的支付。在我的研究环境中，水费账单往往未全额支付，这影响了水务公司的财政可持续性（即成本回收）。我发现支付并未减少。这意味着客户支付了账单中更大比例的费用，因为他们在不减少支付的情况下减少了用水量。

articles.title_en: Global universal basic skills: Current deficits and implications for world development
articles.title_cn: 全球普遍基础技能：当前缺失及其对世界发展的影响
articles.abstract_en: How far is the world away from ensuring that every child obtains the basic skills needed to be competitive in a modern economy? And what would accomplishing this mean for world development? We provide new approaches for estimating the lack of basic skills that allow mapping achievement across countries of the world onto a common (PISA) scale. We then estimate the share of children not achieving basic skills for 159 countries that cover 98% of world population and 99% of world GDP. We find that at least two-thirds of the world's youth do not reach basic skill levels, ranging from 24% in North America to 89% in South Asia and 94% in Sub-Saharan Africa. Our economic analysis suggests that the present value of lost world economic output due to missing the goal of global universal basic skills amounts to over $700 trillion over the remaining century, or 12% of discounted GDP.
articles.abstract_cn: 世界距离确保每个儿童获得在现代经济中具有竞争力所需的基础技能还有多远？实现这一目标对世界发展意味着什么？我们提供了估算基础技能缺失的新方法，使得能够将世界各国学生的学业表现映射到一个共同的（PISA）量表上。然后，我们估算了覆盖世界人口98%和世界GDP 99%的159个国家中未达到基础技能的儿童比例。我们发现，世界上至少三分之二的青年未达到基础技能水平，从北美的24%到南亚的89%和撒哈拉以南非洲的94%不等。我们的经济分析表明，由于未能实现全球普遍基础技能的目标，未来一个世纪内世界经济损失的现值超过700万亿美元，相当于贴现GDP的12%。
